name: Foreign nationals
description: Permanent residents without Swiss citizenship, share of all permanent residents, 31 December of the year before the election.

name: Residents aged 65 and over
description: Permanent residents aged 65 and over, share of all permanent residents, 31 December of the year before the election.

name: Population change over ten years
description: Change in permanent residents over the ten years to 31 December of the year before the election, on today's communes.

name: Residents per km²
description: Permanent residents per square kilometre of the commune's area (lakes included where they belong to the commune).

name: Jobs per 100 residents
description: Employed persons working in the commune per 100 permanent residents: high in centres people commute to, low in places people commute from.

name: Jobs in farming and forestry
description: Employed persons in the primary sector (farming, forestry, fishing), share of all employed persons working in the commune.

name: Median taxable income
description: Estimated median taxable income per tax return, direct federal tax, natural persons (normal cases); tax year of the election.
